summary_for_children: Ash-Shura means Consultation. It praises believers who decide their affairs by consulting each other, and shows signs like ships on the sea that move only by the wind Allah sends.
environment_concept: A harbour of ships like mountains (42:32), ships lying still when the wind stops (42:33) and a circle of seats for deciding together (42:38).
architecture_and_scenery: Large harbour, a calm sea that can turn still, a simple council house with a circle of seats.

story_library.title: The Council of Wisdom
story_library.children_narration: Important decisions are easier to make wisely when people listen to one another. Surah Ash-Shura praises believers who consult together, avoid wrongdoing, and forgive when appropriate. It teaches that strength is not only about winning an argument but also about fairness and self-control.

world_idea.title: The Council House
world_idea.description: Children help a fictional community make decisions by listening to different needs and comparing fair solutions. The scenarios are educational examples, not Quranic historical events.
